```{r Prepare to merge}
Erica_SpKey <- Erica_SpKey %>%
  mutate(recorded_species_name_clean = tolower(recorded_species_name_clean))

Mar_SpKey <- Mar_SpKey %>%
  mutate(common_name = tolower(common_name))
Mar_SpKey_filtered <- Mar_SpKey %>% select(fishery, common_name_IHH= common_name, highest_taxonomic_id, highest_taxonomic_resolution, species, genus, family, order, class, IHH_functional_major_groups_sm)

Hem_SpKey <- Hem_SpKey %>%
  mutate(common_name = tolower(common_name))

Hem_SpKey_filtered <- Hem_SpKey %>%
  select(common_name, species)

Hem_SpKey_filtered <- Hem_SpKey %>%
  select(common_name, species)
```

```{r Merge}
merged_df1 <- stringdist_join(
  Erica_SpKey,
  Mar_SpKey_filtered,
  by = c("recorded_species_name_clean" = "common_name_IHH"),
  method = "jw",          # Jaro-Winkler works well for name matching
  max_dist = 0.15,        # adjust as needed
  distance_col = "dist"   # keep the distance so you can inspect match quality
)

merged_df1 <- merged_df1 %>% distinct()

merged_df2 <- stringdist_join(
  merged_df1,
  Hem_SpKey_filtered,
  by = c("recorded_species_name_clean" = "common_name"),
  method = "jw",          # Jaro-Winkler works well for name matching
  max_dist = 0.15,        # adjust as needed
  distance_col2 = "dist"   # keep the distance so you can inspect match quality
)

```

## Filtering out key words from landing receipts:
```{r Load in the Landings_GoC dataframe}
Landings_GoC<- readRDS(here("/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/goal_prep/fis/v2025/int/juan_carlos/GoC_Landings_2000.present_EMF_created.rds"))
# n = 3716415 obs.
```

```{r Filter out keywords from recorded_species_name to get recorded_species_name_clean}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Keyword list
# ------------------------------------------------------------
keyword_list <- c(
  "S.C.", "S", 
  "ENTERO", "IND", "ENT",
  "FRESCO", "FCA", "FCO",
  "ECO",
  "CONG", "CONGELADO",
  "VIVO", "VIVA", "VIVITA",
  "DE CULTIVO", "DE CULTIVO VIVO", "ABASTO RANCHO", "RANCHO",
  "HUEVA DE",
  "FILETE", "FILETE DE", "ECA", "FILETE DE ECO", "DESHUESADA",
  "DESCABEZADO", "DES", "DSC", "DESC",  "DESV",
  "CABEZA DE", "BUCHE", "BUCHE DE", "TRIPA DE", "COLAS DE",
  "PIEL DE ECA", "PIEL DE SECA", "PIEL DE",
  "SECO DE", "SECA", "SECA DE", "SECO", "SECO DE",
  "COCINERO", "COCIDO", "COCIDA",
  "ALETA", "ALETA ECA DE", "ALETA FCA DE",
  "DE ALTA MAR",
  "CONCHA DE", "CONCHA",
  "POLVO DE",
  "CARNADA", "P/CARNADA",
  "DE AGUA DULCE",
  "MANTO DE", "PULPA DE", "PULPO DE", "TENTACULOS DE", "TUBO DE",
  "NO APTO PARA EMPAQUE"
)

# Sort by descending length to match multi-word keywords first
keyword_list <- keyword_list[order(nchar(keyword_list), decreasing = TRUE)]


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Escape regex metacharacters
# ------------------------------------------------------------
escape_regex <- function(x) {
  str_replace_all(x, "([.|(){}+*?^$\\[\\]\\\\])", "\\\\\\1")
}

keyword_list_escaped <- escape_regex(keyword_list)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Create safe lookaround-based regex
#   This allows punctuation inside keywords (e.g., "S.C.")
# ------------------------------------------------------------
keyword_pattern <- paste0(
  "(?<![A-Za-z0-9])(",
  paste(keyword_list_escaped, collapse = "|"),
  ")(?![A-Za-z0-9])"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Apply the extraction & cleaning
# ------------------------------------------------------------
Landed_Sp_Names <- Landings_GoC %>%
  select(main_species_group, recorded_species_name = species_name) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  
  mutate(
    keywords = str_extract_all(recorded_species_name, keyword_pattern)
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(keywords = lapply(keywords, function(x) { length(x) <- 5; x })) %>%
  unnest_wider(keywords, names_sep = "_") %>%
  
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    recorded_species_name_clean =
      if_else(
        recorded_species_name %in% c(
          "TIBURON ALETA BLANCA",
          "BERRUGATA ALETA AMARILLA",
          "CORVINA ALETA CORTA",
          "CORVINA ALETA AMARILLA"
        ),
        recorded_species_name,
        str_remove_all(recorded_species_name, keyword_pattern)
      ),
    
  # Remove the standalone "Y"
  recorded_species_name_clean = str_remove_all(recorded_species_name_clean, "\\bY\\b"),
  
  # NEW: clean up leftover punctuation such as ". ." or "."
  recorded_species_name_clean = str_replace_all(recorded_species_name_clean, "[.]+", " "),
  
  # Collapse whitespace
  recorded_species_name_clean = str_squish(recorded_species_name_clean)
) %>%
ungroup()

length(unique(Landed_Sp_Names$recorded_species_name_clean))
# 848 unique names
```
